# Larson Safety LLC

> Occupational safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance consulting
> for small and mid-sized industrial and manufacturing employers in
> Northeast Florida, owned and operated by a Board Certified Safety
> Professional (CSP) with 30+ years of industrial EHS leadership experience.

Larson Safety exists for employers who need real safety and environmental
expertise but don't have — and don't want the overhead of — a full-time
safety director. Engagements range from a single compliance audit to
ongoing fractional safety leadership.

## Services

- Regulatory Compliance (OSHA/EPA): program review, records, reports,
  training programs, and agency pre- and post-interaction support.
- Written Safety Program Development: Hazard Communication, Fall
  Protection, Emergency Management, Heat Stress, Lockout/Tagout, Job Hazard
  Analysis, and more, tailored per operation rather than templated.
- Safety & Environmental Program Audits: gap analysis against current OSHA
  standards with a prioritized action plan.
- Insurance Risk Management: property and workers' compensation risk
  assessment and mitigation strategy.
- Environmental Health & Safety Management Platform: a hosted application
  for regulatory reports, training records, permits, insurance records, and
  incident data.
- Fractional Safety Support: short-term coverage through ongoing fractional
  safety and environmental leadership.

## Industries served

General industry (building facilities management, hospitality, industrial
services, distribution and warehousing) and manufacturing (metal, plastics,
packaging, printing, truck/auto upfitting and repair, boat manufacturing).

## Free self-assessment tool

https://larsonsafe.com/assessment/larson-safety-risk-assessment.html — a
free, 20-question, ~5-minute self-assessment covering Occupational Safety &
Health, Environmental Management, Insurance & Loss Control, and Regulatory
& Agency Readiness. Entirely client-side; nothing is sent anywhere unless
the visitor opts in to share their results.
